name: S.S. Tidal
lines:
Oh... It’s you.
How about it? How’s the old S.S. Tidal treating you?
I can tell from the sea breeze on my skin
that my old friend has still got it.

Could you scoot over a bit more?
You did say you wanted to sit in a seat on the deck...

Such an elegant moment as I gaze
out upon the interminable sea...
My Slakoth is pleased, too,
so I’m glad I brought it along!
There’s a weird old guy at the front of the bow...

There was a big Wailord breaching just now!
Oh! By the way, breaching is what you call
it when a Wailord or a Wailmer jumps as
high as it can for everyone on the ship.
